data.title: This Eric Trump-Backed Startup Just Got AMD's Chips for Its Humanoid Robots— Now It's Building Military Versions Too, Reviving Conflict-Of-Interest Fears
data.description: Eric Trump-backed Foundation Future Industries will use Advanced Micro Devices Inc. chips to develop autonomous humanoid robots for factories and military operations, with industrial customers paying about $100,000 annually to lease each machine.
